_note: The meeting on Young Lancashire Voice: the order of business, the roles for a class and the questions to talk over. Read by the game page and by the paper sheets under /young-lancashire-voice/paper/, so the two cannot drift. A role is [name, what it does in the game, what it does on paper where the wording differs]. Keep figures out: a published figure needs a source.
agenda: Say so if a decision could affect you
Anyone can ask the council a question
Councillors ask the people in charge
A councillor asks the council to act
roles: The Chairman
Runs the meeting. Reads the Chairman's words, calls each speaker and announces every result.
Runs the meeting. Calls each speaker in turn and announces every result.
The Chief Executive
Reads the apologies, and helps the Chairman count the hands.
A Cabinet Member
Answers the questions and moves the report on library rules.
Answers the questions, and moves a report for the meeting to agree.
The questioner
Asks the public question about the crossing, from the public seats.
Asks a public question from the public seats.
The mover
Sits in the chosen seat. Asks a question, moves the class motion and has the last word. Makes the choices on the screen, with help from the room.
Asks a question, moves the class motion and has the last word.
The seconder
Backs the report, and then the motion, so that each can be debated.
A councillor with an amendment
Asks for one change to the motion.
A speaker for the motion
Makes a short speech for it. Read the words on the screen or use your own.
Makes a short speech for it, in their own words.
A speaker against the motion
Makes a short speech against it. Argue with the idea, never the person.
Councillors
Everyone else. Listen to the debate, then vote by raising a hand.
Reporters
One or two people who do not vote. Write one sentence that says what the meeting decided.
debrief: Did anyone change their mind during the debate? What changed it?
Was the amendment a fair change, or did it weaken the motion?
Who did not speak, and what would they have said?
If this cost money, what would you spend less on to pay for it?
Which of the real ways to be heard would you use to take this further?
